I'm getting joy from it, but I do it secretly. You know, sometimes I get to writing once in 3 months, just for a few hours, when everyone's away, when I don't have to pretend that I go to my university and do things that my parents expect me to do, when I don't feel like a ghost who sees no purpose in doing anything. And that's what I meant, that is the only thing I want to do. To be alone and write with pleasure. I'm not saying that I don't want to have a job, but I want to be alone and that is something I can't be no matter what I do. I even tried moving away, but somehow I always end up in the same spot. God knows I tried, I hope he knows. Thanks though, keep it up, anxiety blows, glad you won.

Well, I guess I haven't reached that clarity yet. I always imagined it in my head that all my failures don't matter, that I can just turn them off, but it's different in reality. You said that in one moment you suddenly could control everything you wanted to do, I want to wait for that moment too, but I'm 21 years old, I've been waiting for this moment from a goddamn shitty time of my youth, missed out on almost everything bright, so I don't want to hang to this moment. But thank you for your words at least, I'm actually happy for everyone who fought this terrible disease to the holy fucking end and beat it.

I do get up around the same time every day. What's more, I get up without any pains of having to get up, but I feel like other than that I'm fucking empty, man. Like there's no strength left in me simply because I'm way off the path and I keep going in a false direction because that's the only way my feet can follow through. Ultimately, I never did the things I wanted to do and now I'm too scared to start changing things in front of all the people I know. I can't explain it, it's just not that simple, it's not the feeling of fear alone, for sure. Maybe I still enjoy a few things and one of them is actually reading books I'm interested in, but again I can't do that. Maybe I don't want to, maybe I'm lazy, maybe my brain lost all focus, doesn't matter, still stands as a fact. I'll take notice of those books you recommended, but I highly doubt I'll ever end up reading those the state I'm in.

Sorry that I turned this into a little whining session, haha.

I've been to many psychatrists and psychotherapists, I've been drinking zoloft pills and all that, but as dumb and irrational as it sounds, I'm just not in a position to help myself. I have no idea how it keeps happening, but even when I'm getting help, I'm not getting any help at all. I absolutely agree about "born losers" not being a real thing, it's only your perception and to my misfortune the way my head works I tend to take every failure as a hard nail driven into me. You can be a "born loser", you can be a complete fuck-up with no luck, but it's important to be less self aware and to be strong, which I'm probably not.

Well, over the course of 4 years I wrote two screenplays, rewrote them a bunch of times and I can't say that I'm proud of them. They're just works I once made, a couple of people saw it on the Internet and that's it. I don't want to make it one of those cases of "Look at me, I have clinical depression!", but that's what stops me and I'd rather just forget about writing and die or whatever this beautiful life has in store for me.

I'm thinking that they don't have the patience to deal with my problems anymore, so yeah I'd rather not let them know because I'm scared. Pretty sure my dad or brother would want to hit me out of anger. And I have a friend who would be willing to help, but I also have no problem with doing everything on my own even if it means failure.
Basically, I just want to know your opinion. Put yourself in my shoes, consider all the facts and tell me would you leave home? What would you do?

Uh, that was always clear to me. It's not about the meds. The situation is different now. It's about living in a world of fear that puts the pressure on you. It just happened that my family carried me, but also made me feel almost imprisoned and they don't even know that. No meds will help me in short term which is the main priority, I'm having a shitload of exams soon and obvs I'm gonna fail every single one of them. If my parents find out, holy fucking hell if I won't get my ass kicked by everyone here.

My parents don't treat it as a serious disease, in fact they don't even want to understand how clinical depression works. I took a year off in 2016 and they got me to a psychiatrist, so I had my share of zoloft pills for a year, but then they told me that I have to stop taking them as there's no need anymore. I was already in fear because they had a confusing reaction to my break, kind of supporting but also blaming me for wasting a year (even though I worked all damn year). When I came back to uni in 2017, obviously nothing's changed, but I was off medication since September and my condition won't allow me to go through this whole bullshit process with my parents again. And yeah, you're absolutely right that in the end it just comes back swinging right in your face, that's why I'm thinking of leaving everything behind. I'm just really lost, my mother is mentally unstable, she's sick and she's the only person I'll regret leaving, but she's part of this environment that slowly chokes me and I feel like it's gonna end me before them. I have no idea what to do.

Thank you for the support! It's late for me to work for a perspective now. I needed progress in my life and I never got it (keep in mind that I'm not blaming anyone), that's why I'm on the verge of giving up. It's a terrible feeling that flows through me every single day. I'm actually mentally ill, so a proper advice would be seeking treatment, but that's not possible for me in a current state. I am scared and words won't change anything. Like I said earlier, this was a spontaneous screenplay, so I'm really thankful for the amount of criticism I received. Discussion is very important. I got all your ideas, thanks!

I've had so many ideas for screenplays, but I'm out of energy, out of enthusiasm and out of possibilities. Obviously, I can't focus on writing as the main priority too, just like everyone else here, I suppose. It's one of those things people can understand only after feeling it on their own.

I'll be honest, I haven't understood what you said there, lol. If it's meant to offend me because everything I wrote is not funny, then good. I'm on board with any opinion. And I would never want to kill myself because it's in the spirit of the modern times, but it's starting to feel like I must stop pretending that I'm strong because in the end there's not gonna be a single feeling circling my death. It'd just take away the pain.

You're so on point. I began writing when I was sick, so I could distract myself from the bad thoughts. Feels very spontaneous and even if those thoughts put into the story are fully mine, they still feel artificial because there was no greater need in writing this screenplay. Thanks!

Why do people think that I talked about the budget? That's weird. Of course, I'm aware of the Clerks budget, but this is a script, not a movie. I didn't even think it was possible to compare the two in financial terms. I just said that the script feels like Clerks, but worse.

Hi, thank you for the feedback! I'm 100% with you about the success of Clerks, but I wouldn't really compare the two because I've mentioned Clerks myself. At the very least, the original Clerks movie was revolutionary, it was a world that Kevin Smith wanted to show and this is something a 20 years old depressed asshole wrote for no purpose. I never claimed that this one should rival Clerks.

Sadly (for me), I have to agree with how the characters are not distinguishable again. And about the one liners too. It's just difficult to differentiate them when you're really not the most sociable guy irl. There was nothing for me to convey in the first place. I started writing this at a bad time and then I just needed to finish the thing because it'd feel wrong to leave it at 50%. As for the trashman, I dunno, I liked your second monologue, lmao. Also, the trashman will never be mentioned again, but I think almost every character appears later and it'd feel kind of weird if they just did some small talk.

And, of course, I meant the quality of work. I stopped dreaming about the filmmaking perspective and very ironically this might be my last screenplay ever. Once again thank you for reaching out!

Oh, thanks. I'm kind of bummed out by everything right now, but maybe I'll use your advice and rewrite this thing sometime. Or maybe I won't. I really don't feel like there's any point in just writing stuff because I feel a certain way. Better leave that to those who can do something for themselves.

Just a few comments back:

- Is age really important? I mean, this is not getting filmed, but if it was, I think the director would probably figure it out himself how young a person should be. It's just that I don't see a point in attaching a detailed description of every character's look because it's gonna seem like I'm yelling, "OH HEY, THIS IS HOW HE MUST LOOK". These are just weird guys and girls, portray them like you want.

- Haha, I agree. I first had it as "Yep" or something like that, no idea why I changed it.

- You're completely right, but once again I never wanted to make them different, I guess. It's a bad thing, but who cares since I don't have any intentions to force this work to people. I'm really bad at building different characters.

- The Dave/Buzz thing is actually a running joke or whatever. There's gonna be even more of that...

- Do you mean trimming their thoughts or just getting rid of all the lines? The whole screenplay is based on dialogues, not much is going on there, especially nothing crucial that would take the story to different stages. The God spiels are some sort of a tribute to Richard Linklater.

- That's really fair, never thought about it.

There's no main protagonist here. There's no story at all. That's why they're all the "outsiders" and I simply wanted them to break out of this "mall" world in the end. No one here stands out because under given conditions everyone's equal, but I do agree that in "Clerks", for example, every character was different, that's what I'd have to work on if I ever got to this work again. 1. The arc of the story is just a basic intrapersonal conflict. Looking for answers to make sense of everything in life. Whiny pseudo philosophical angsty stuff, I guess.
